summary: Comprehensive architectural implementation plan for 'Cult' — next-generation modular Android streaming app featuring a custom pure-Java and FFmpeg/MediaCodec JNI media engine (zero ExoPlayer/Media3), QuickJS runtime extension bridge for dynamic providers with local caching and background updates, frosted glassmorphism UI with Haze blur, Material 3 Expressive morphing loaders, and full movie/series browsing and playback flows.
